ModMetaData.name: Nice Health Tab - RJW Genitalia
ModMetaData.author: zoc2k
ModMetaData.description:
Shows RimJobWorld's reproductive body parts on the Nice Health Tab doll.
REQUIRED: Nice Health Tab and RimJobWorld. Without either, this mod does nothing.
ON THE DOLL - Breasts, nipples, penis or vulva, and testicles are drawn on the body like any other outer body part. - The womb, ovaries and testicles are also organs. On the normal view they appear only when injured, bleeding, diseased, missing or implanted; in the organ view they are always shown and clickable. - The anus has its own small window at the lower right of the doll, shown on both the normal and organ views, even when the pawn has no anus. - The art changes with part size, and follows the parts a pawn actually has rather than its gender, so futa and transgender pawns look right. - Health colours, implants and missing parts are handled by Nice Health Tab. Click a part to schedule surgery on it, like any other organ.
RJW PART PANEL A button at the lower right of the doll shows a close-up of the pawn's crotch. Press it to open a panel over the doll, like the hand and foot panels, with the genitals enlarged, the anus, and the ovulation / fertilization / implantation state. Press it again to close.
SIZE HEDIFFS RimJobWorld stores part size as an always-present hediff, which would keep these parts permanently lit up on the doll. This mod leaves plain size hediffs out of the doll's condition check, so the parts behave like every other organ. Sizes are still listed on the right. Bionic parts and harmful hediffs still show.
OPTIONAL MODS - each adds features; without it only those features are missing - RJW Menstruation: fluid in the womb (6 stages, turns red with menstrual blood), per-pawn areola pigmentation, and the ovulation / fertilization / implantation state in the panel. - RJW Menstruation - Fluids: womb inflation (5 stages). - Sized Apparel: inverted nipple art. - RJW Now with balls! . . . and Ovaries I guess: real testicle and ovary sizes, translated gonad names, and gonad removal split into testicle removal and ovary removal. Without it, pawns with a vagina get a reference ovary picture and pawns with a penis get testicles matched to penis size. - Cumpilation: stops the red "Tried to add health diff to missing part" log error when a pawn's genitals are missing.
MOD SETTINGS - Show genitals on the child body type (default off). This goes by doll, not age - Nice Health Tab decides which pawns use the child doll. - Show the RJW part panel (default on). - Ignore plain size hediffs on the doll (default on). - Show chest on male pawns (default off). - Nipples: show them, follow skin colour, follow areola pigmentation, show inverted nipples, draw in black and white. - Show testicles on futanari (default off). Hiding a marker only hides the picture; injuries, treatment and surgery work as usual. The settings page lists which linked mods were found (hover a mod to see what it adds), and options that need a missing mod are locked.
No original files of Nice Health Tab, RimJobWorld or the linked mods are modified or redistributed. The textures were made for this mod.
Load order: put this below Nice Health Tab, RimJobWorld and the balls mod.
